facts.fact: inwi opened its fourth data center, 1,000 sq m at Rabat Technopolis, to offer hosting services to Moroccan companies; inwi says it now has 4,000 sq m under management.

inwi says the new Rabat Technopolis data center holds Uptime Institute Tier Certification of Design Documents (TCDD), with Constructed Facility certification due soon (tier level not stated in the text).

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
